shared: One water Level decides your fights, and the water reaches both boards, so it can drown your own units too.
differ: What the water does: chips front-row Health, sets every unit's shared Health, or halves sunk units' Attack.

takes.label: Front-row flood
takes.line: The Flood shaves a tenth of front-row Health per Level on both boards; floating coots and Dike beavers make a seating puzzle.
takes.look_if: a front-row seating puzzle and big swings of the water.

takes.label: One shared Health
takes.line: Every Board unit has the same Health, a Pool split by seats filled, so each buy asks: three walls or seven attackers?
takes.look_if: a wide-or-tall vote on every buy, with other tribes paying in.

takes.label: Scout, then vote
takes.line: Both players' Levels add up to the water; sunk units hit at half Attack, so you scout your next opponent, then vote.
takes.look_if: to tune the water to each opponent you scout.
